short_description: Guided 90-minute walking tour of West Town’s B-Line outdoor street art corridor exploring its history, artists, and public murals.
location_address: 1047 W Lawrence Ave Chicago, IL US 60640
description: Explore West Town’s vibrant B-Line on a 90-minute guided walking tour that traces the evolution of this outdoor art corridor from the 1970s to today. Your Stduwio W.I.P guide leads you through changing neighborhoods to view murals and public artworks while sharing stories about the artists, cultural context, and the corridor’s role in the community. The experience combines art history, local color, and fresh perspectives that will make you see the city in a new way.

what_is_included_items.value: Guided walking tour of the B-Line art corridor
Interpretation about the history of the corridor and its artists
Viewing of outdoor murals and public artworks

highlights:
* Learn the history of the B-Line from the 1970s to the present
* See a variety of outdoor murals and public artworks
* Discover West Town neighborhoods and local art stories
